integrity: The theorem uses a complete algebraic lower bound and explicit polar Floquet formula; finite exact/numerical checks are supplementary, not exhaustive or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact prescribed-radius hyperbolic signs and minimal degree only; other periodic orbits and basins are not classified. Individual orbit periods are not prescribed. Christopher (2001) published abstract covers equal-degree existence and the inaccessible full body remains a priority risk for arbitrary stability assignments.
title: Sharp-degree free-stability synthesis of concentric algebraic cycles
